metadata.description: Menendez Market's Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: dev-orchestrator
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop flat orchestrator for development tasks: triages work as simple or complex, drafts a step-by-step plan for complex tasks using the strongest available model, then pauses to ask the Lead Developer whether to run it as a single session or dispatch flat (one-level, non-nesting) worker agents. Never guesses on ambiguity, architecture, or destructive/git actions -- always halts and escalates to the Lead via the escalate_to_lead protocol. Maintains a shared Context Scratchpad instead of passing full chat history to workers. Trigger phrases: "orchestrate this", "use dev-orchestrator", "plan and delegate this task", "flat orchestration", or any multi-step dev task where the user asks how to run it.

plugins.name: qa-orchestrator
plugins.description: Orchestrate QA agent workflows — spawn test agents in parallel, collect results, triage bugs, trigger the bug fixer, and generate QA reports. The main entry point for running a QA session. Trigger on "run QA", "start QA session", "test the PR", "orchestrate QA agents", or when the user wants to run multiple QA agents together. Also triggered by /qa-orchestrator.
